Generating AI images from text prompts

Batch editing many photos at once
summary.what_it_does:
Fotor is a browser-based photo editor offering basic adjustments like brightness and contrast, portrait retouching, cropping, text, and effects, plus a batch editor for processing many photos at once. Its AI tools include one-click photo enhancement, background removal, object removal, and text-prompt image generation. Other AI features cover adding or replacing objects via brushed areas, outpainting to extend images beyond their borders, and turning selfies into avatars. The page also lists filters, stock photos, stickers, fonts, and collage templates.</what_it_does>
